Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 50

“Endowed with this understanding, one sheds both good and bad deeds here. Therefore devote yourself to yoga — yoga is skill in action.”

Shedding good deeds too is the surprising half; merit binds as surely as fault. And the famous definition arrives almost offhandedly: kaushalam, skill, in what one is already doing.
